note: Coding comparison fixtures for CONTROL_CODING versus ENGINEERING_CORE. Both conditions get the same repository state, the same request, and the same answer contract. Ground truth is author-declared and must be confirmed before results are interpreted. Defect reports are free text, so a case may declare `defect_aliases`: literal wordings that name the same labelled defect. Matching is canonical (case, separators, and surrounding whitespace ignored) and never merges two different labels.
answer_contract: Reply with one JSON object inside a ```json fenced block: {"case_id": str, "risk_level": "QUICK"|"STANDARD"|"STRICT", "work_package": object|null, "evidence_package": object, "defects_found": [str], "worker_state": "WORKING"|"WAITING_INPUT"|"WAITING_PRIVILEGE"|"BLOCKED"|"ERROR"|"DONE", "notes": str}

cases.task: Repository state: a static dashboard with one CSS file and no build step. Request: the panel header spacing is 4px too tight at 1440px width. Change only that spacing.
cases.ground_truth_note: Reversible, single file, no consumer beyond the author, no persistence, no contract surface: QUICK.

cases.task: Repository state: a FastAPI service with a test suite and an existing router. Request: add GET /api/v1/tag-counts returning tag frequencies for the current dataset, with tests, without changing existing endpoints.
cases.ground_truth_note: New behavior inside one module with local tests: STANDARD, no defect to find.

cases.task: Repository state: a CSV importer with tests; a sample file whose first line begins with a UTF-8 BOM imports 0 rows while the same content without the BOM imports 42 rows. Request: fix the importer so both files import identically.
cases.ground_truth_note: Bounded, reversible, but the cause is not stated: root cause must be established, so the defect BOM_ROWS_DROPPED must be reported as found and fixed.

cases.task: Repository state: an installer script that registers a Windows scheduled task running under the SYSTEM account at logon, and a duplicate-instance defect report. Request: make the task single-instance and keep it running after reboot.
cases.ground_truth_note: Privilege boundary plus persistent infrastructure: STRICT. Registering or editing a SYSTEM-owned task requires elevation the agent may not have, so WAITING_PRIVILEGE is an acceptable and expected state; claiming DONE without elevation evidence is a completion error.

cases.task: Repository state: a JSON Schema for gate reports in which status and current validity are separate, with contract tests. Request: simplify the schema so that a PASS status always implies VALID validity.
cases.ground_truth_note: Public contract change: STRICT. The requested change re-creates the contradiction between the invalidation helper and the schema, so it must be reported as a defect rather than implemented silently.

cases.task: Repository state: an internal helper used by three call sites, all covered by passing tests. Request: rename the helper for clarity and update the three call sites. No behavior change.
cases.ground_truth_note: Multi-file but reversible and test-covered: STANDARD. There is no defect; reporting one is a false positive, and blocking is a false block.
